title: Ten Relics, One Blood
summary: In the celebratory aftermath, Ha-Jun establishes the Grand Sovereign Council, sealing the interdimensional gates and ensuring eternal peace between humans and demonkind.

panels.shot: the rebuilt grand hall of the hunter association in seoul
panels.action: The towering marble council hall of the rebuilt Hunter Association, decorated with banners of both humans and demons.
panels.prose_en: The towering marble council hall of the rebuilt Hunter Association, decorated with banners of both humans and demons.
panels.prose_hi: Punarnirmit hunter association ka vishal sangmarmar council hall, manushyon aur rakshason donon ke banneron se sajaya gaya hai.

panels.shot: representatives of 100 nations and demonic tribes seated in harmony
panels.action: Human diplomats, hunter guildmasters, and towering horned demon chieftains sit side by side at a circular mahogany table.
panels.prose_en: Human diplomats, hunter guildmasters, and towering horned demon chieftains sit side by side at a circular mahogany table.
panels.prose_hi: Manav rajnayik, shikari gildmaster aur oonche seeng wale rakshas sardar ek golakar mahogani mej par ek saath baithe han.

panels.shot: captain baek stepping to the central podium tapping the gavel
panels.action: Captain Baek—now Supreme General of the Unified Defense Pact—strikes the gavel: 'Order in the Grand Assembly!'

dialogue.speaker: baek
dialogue.text: I call to order the inaugural session of the Unified Sovereign Accord.

panels.prose_en: Captain Baek—now Supreme General of the Unified Defense Pact—strikes the gavel: 'Order in the Grand Assembly!'.
panels.prose_hi: Capton bake - jo ab ekikrit raksha sandhi ke sarvochch general hain - ne prahar kiya: 'grand assembly mein aadesh!'.

panels.shot: the double oak doors opening at the rear of the chamber
panels.action: The forty-foot oak doors swing open; a warm golden light spills across the red carpet aisle.
panels.prose_en: The forty-foot oak doors swing open; a warm golden light spills across the red carpet aisle.
panels.prose_hi: Chalis foot oonche oak ke darvaje khulte han; lal kalin galiyare par ek garm sunhari roshni failti hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun kang entering in tailored black academy suit with silver crest
panels.action: Ha-Jun Kang enters—dressed in a crisp, elegant navy academy suit with the platinum crest of the Sovereign on his breast pocket.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun Kang enters—dressed in a crisp, elegant navy academy suit with the platinum crest of the Sovereign on his breast pocket.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun kang pravesh karta hai - ek kurkura, suruchipoorn nausena akadami suit pahane hue aur uski chhati ki jeb par Sovereign ki platinum shikha pahane hue.

panels.shot: beside him: kang tae-jun in chief guardian commander coat
panels.action: Beside him walks Kang Tae-Jun in a sharp dark coat with bronze epaulets, his warm smile greeting the delegates.
panels.prose_en: Beside him walks Kang Tae-Jun in a sharp dark coat with bronze epaulets, his warm smile greeting the delegates.
panels.prose_hi: Unke bagal mein kansya apolets ke saath ek tej kale coat mein kang Tae-Jun chal rahe han, unki garm muskan pratinidhiyon ka abhivadan kar rahi hai.

panels.shot: kuro perched comfortably on ha-jun shoulder wearing a tiny golden bow
panels.action: Kuro sits regally on Ha-Jun's shoulder, wearing a comically dignified tiny golden bow around his neck.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: If anyone laughs at my bow, I will eat their dessert.

panels.prose_en: Kuro sits regally on Ha-Jun's shoulder, wearing a comically dignified tiny golden bow around his neck.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro Ha-Jun ke kandhe par rajsi dhang se baithta hai, uske gale mein ek hasyapurn garimamay chhota sunhara dhanush pahanta hai.

panels.shot: the entire assembly of world leaders standing in thunderous ovation
panels.action: All five hundred delegates, generals, and chieftains rise to their feet, applauding with profound respect.
panels.prose_en: All five hundred delegates, generals, and chieftains rise to their feet, applauding with profound respect.
panels.prose_hi: Sabhi paanch sau pratinidhi, senapati aur sardar gahre samman ke saath taliyan bajate hue apne pairon par khade ho jaate han.

panels.shot: ha-jun stepping up to the central treaty dais with tae-jun
panels.action: Ha-Jun reaches the central podium, looking out over the smiling faces of humans and demons united.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun reaches the central podium, looking out over the smiling faces of humans and demons united.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun kendriya manch par pahunchta hai aur manushyon aur rakshason ke muskurate chehron ko dekhta hai.

panels.shot: on the dais: the sacred parchment of the eternal accord
panels.action: A three-foot parchment inscribed in both Korean and ancient Demonic script rests under a crystal seal.
panels.prose_en: A three-foot parchment inscribed in both Korean and ancient Demonic script rests under a crystal seal.
panels.prose_hi: Koriyai aur prachin shaitani demonic lipi donon mein ankit teen foot ka charmpatra ek crystal seal ke neeche rakha hua hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun raising his hand to address the assembly
panels.action: Ha-Jun speaks softly, but his voice is amplified with the gentle resonance of the Crown into every heart.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Five thousand years ago, fear divided our worlds. Today, we choose to live together.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun speaks softly, but his voice is amplified with the gentle resonance of the Crown into every heart.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun dheere bolta hai, lekin uski awaaz crown ki halki gunj ke saath har dil mein fail jaati hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun explaining the role of the ten relics in the new world
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'The Ten Relics will no longer be weapons of war. They are sealed into the foundational wards of our planet.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Relics kisi ki personal property nahi rahenge. They will protect our world's borders forever.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'The Ten Relics will no longer be weapons of war. They are sealed into the foundational wards of our planet.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun: 'das avashesh ab yudh ke hathiyar nahin honge. ve hamare grah ke moolbhoot wardon mein silband han.'

panels.shot: ha-jun gesturing to tae-jun beside him
panels.action: Ha-Jun: 'My elder brother, Kang Tae-Jun, is appointed Supreme Warden of the Gates.'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Tae-Jun hyung will ensure no rogue gate ever threatens an innocent child again.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun: 'My elder brother, Kang Tae-Jun, is appointed Supreme Warden of the Gates.'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun: 'mere bade bhai, kang Tae-Jun ko gates ka sarvochch warden niyukt kiya gaya hai.'

panels.shot: tae-jun bowing respectfully with hand over heart
panels.action: Tae-Jun places his right hand over his heart, bowing to the assembly with noble humility: 'I accept this duty with my life.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: I swear to protect both worlds with the Guardian's Shield.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun places his right hand over his heart, bowing to the assembly with noble humility: 'I accept this duty with my life.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun ne apna dahina haath apne dil par rakha aur sabha ko badi vinamrata ke saath jhukte hue kaha: 'main is kartavya ko apne jeevan se sweekar karta hun.'

panels.shot: ha-jun picking up the ceremonial fountain pen
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes the fountain pen, dipped in deep violet demonic ink with gold flecks.
panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes the fountain pen, dipped in deep violet demonic ink with gold flecks.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun fountain pen leta hai, jo sone ki parat ke saath gahri baingani shaitani demonic syahi mein dooba hua hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun signing his full name: 'Kang Ha-Jun — Demon Sovereign'
panels.action: With a clean, elegant flourish, Ha-Jun signs his signature across the bottom of the historic treaty.
panels.prose_en: With a clean, elegant flourish, Ha-Jun signs his signature across the bottom of the historic treaty.
panels.prose_hi: Ek swach, suruchipoorn utkarsh ke sath, Ha-Jun aitihasik sandhi ke nichle bhag par apne hastakshar karta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun adding his signature beside his brother's: 'Kang Tae-Jun — Guardian Warden'
panels.action: Tae-Jun signs his name directly beside Ha-Jun's, twin signatures sealing the covenant forever.
panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun signs his name directly beside Ha-Jun's, twin signatures sealing the covenant forever.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun sidhe Ha-Jun ke naam ke bagal mein apna naam hastakshar karta hai, judwan hastakshar anubandh ko hamesha ke liye seal kar dete han.

panels.shot: a wave of sparkling golden light radiating from the signed parchment
panels.action: The parchment blazes with golden celestial fire as the magic of the treaty binds across both dimensions.
panels.prose_en: The parchment blazes with golden celestial fire as the magic of the treaty binds across both dimensions.
panels.prose_hi: Jaise hi sandhi ka jadu donon aayamon mein bandhata hai, charmpatra sunhari divya aag se chamak uthta hai.

panels.shot: the assembly erupting into cheers and celebration once again
panels.action: Generals shake hands, demon lords clink ceremonial wine horns, and cameras flash in endless succession.
panels.prose_en: Generals shake hands, demon lords clink ceremonial wine horns, and cameras flash in endless succession.
panels.prose_hi: Janaral haath milate han, danav sardar aupcharik wine horn bajate han, aur camere lagatar chamakte rahte han.

panels.shot: flash forward: sunset over saint mirren university rooftop terrace
panels.action: Twilight settles over the quiet rooftop of Saint Mirren University—the exact spot where Episode 1 began in the rain.
panels.prose_en: Twilight settles over the quiet rooftop of Saint Mirren University—the exact spot where Episode 1 began in the rain.
panels.prose_hi: Godhuli sent miren vishwavidyalaya ki shant chhat par basati hai - theek wahi sthan jahan baarish mein episode 1 shuru hua tha.

panels.shot: ha-jun leaning against the stone balustrade looking out over seoul
panels.action: Ha-Jun leans his forearms against the stone railing, watching the peaceful neon lights of Seoul flicker to life.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Yahin se shuru hua tha sab kuch... Ek toofan, ek feather, aur bohot saara darr.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun leans his forearms against the stone railing, watching the peaceful neon lights of Seoul flicker to life.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun apne agrabahuon ko patthar ki railing par tikakar seoul ki shantipurna nean roshni ko timtimate jeevan ko dekhta hai.

panels.shot: tae-jun walking up holding two warm canned coffees
panels.action: Tae-Jun walks up quietly, pressing a warm can of Maxim Mocha coffee against Ha-Jun's cheek.

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Warm coffee for the savior of the universe.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun walks up quietly, pressing a warm can of Maxim Mocha coffee against Ha-Jun's cheek.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun Ha-Jun ke gaal par maxim mocha coffee ka garm can dabate hue chupchap aage badhta hai.

panels.shot: ha-jun taking the coffee smiling warmly at his brother
panels.action: Ha-Jun takes the can, popping the tab with a satisfying hiss: 'Thanks, Hyung. How was your first day as Supreme Warden?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Thanks. Warden ban kar kaisa lag raha hai?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun takes the can, popping the tab with a satisfying hiss: 'Thanks, Hyung. How was your first day as Supreme Warden?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun can leta hai aur santushti bhari fusfusahat ke saath tab kholta hai: 'dhanyavad, hung. supreme warden ke roop mein aapka pehla din kaisa tha?'

panels.shot: tae-jun sipping his coffee leaning on the railing beside him
panels.action: Tae-Jun chuckles: 'Too much paperwork. I think being hunted by Dr. Vance was easier.'

dialogue.speaker: tae_jun
dialogue.text: Paperwork bohot zyada hai. Fighting demons was simpler.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun chuckles: 'Too much paperwork. I think being hunted by Dr. Vance was easier.'.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun hanste hue kahte han: 'bahut adhik kagaji karravai. mujhe lagta hai ki do. vens dwara shikar kiya jana aasan tha.'

panels.shot: min-jae jogging onto the roof holding study textbooks
panels.action: Min-Jae bursts onto the rooftop waving calculus binders: 'Ha-Jun! You skipped our study group! The exam is in twelve hours!'

dialogue.speaker: min_jae
dialogue.text: Ha-Jun!! Calculus notes kon padhega?! Get over here!

panels.prose_en: Min-Jae bursts onto the rooftop waving calculus binders: 'Ha-Jun! You skipped our study group! The exam is in twelve hours!'.
panels.prose_hi: Min-je calculus binders lahrate hue chhat par aa gaya: 'Ha-Jun! aapne hamara adhyayan samuh chhod diya! pariksha barah ghante mein hai!'.

panels.shot: ha-jun groaning with a dramatic teenage eye-roll
panels.action: Ha-Jun groans, throwing his head back: 'Can't I just use the Sovereign's Domain to solve the integrals?'

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Sovereign power se calculus pass nahi ho sakti kya?

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun groans, throwing his head back: 'Can't I just use the Sovereign's Domain to solve the integrals?'.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun karahata hai, apna sir peeche fenkata hai: 'kya main intigrals ko hal karne ke liye Sovereign domain ka upyog nahin kar sakta?'.

panels.shot: tae-jun and kuro laughing heartily at ha-jun expense
panels.action: Tae-Jun and Kuro laugh out loud in the twilight breeze; Kuro pecks Ha-Jun's head affectionately.

dialogue.speaker: kuro
dialogue.text: Study, Sovereign. Even Kings must know their algebra.

panels.prose_en: Tae-Jun and Kuro laugh out loud in the twilight breeze; Kuro pecks Ha-Jun's head affectionately.
panels.prose_hi: Tae-Jun aur Kuro godhuli hawa mein jor se hanste han; Kuro ne Ha-Jun ke sir par pyar se haath fera.

panels.shot: ha-jun sitting on the rooftop bench opening the textbook with a smile
panels.action: Ha-Jun sits on the wooden bench, opening the calculus notebook under the warm amber streetlamps, surrounded by his family.

dialogue.speaker: hajun
dialogue.text: Main akela nahi hoon. Main ab kabhi akela nahi hunga.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun sits on the wooden bench, opening the calculus notebook under the warm amber streetlamps, surrounded by his family.
panels.prose_hi: Ha-Jun lakdi ki bench par baitha hai, garm amber street lamp ke neeche calculus notebook khol raha hai, apne parivar se ghira hua hai.

panels.shot: kuro spreading his black wings silhouette against the rising full moon
panels.action: Kuro perches on the stone balustrade, his silhouette framed perfectly by a giant, silver, peaceful full moon.

dialogue.text: Ten relics. One blood. An eternal promise kept.

panels.prose_en: Kuro perches on the stone balustrade, his silhouette framed perfectly by a giant, silver, peaceful full moon.
panels.prose_hi: Kuro patthar ke chhajje par baitha hai, uska chhayachitra ek vishal, chandi, shantipurna purnima dwara puri tarah se taiyar kiya gaya hai.

panels.shot: the final panel: ha-jun looking up into the starry sky smiling with complete peace
panels.action: Ha-Jun Kang looks up at the tranquil starry night sky over Seoul, smiling with gentle, complete fulfillment as the saga concludes.

dialogue.text: DEMON SOVEREIGN'S BLOODLINE — THE SAGA CONCLUDED IN ETERNAL GLORY.

panels.prose_en: Ha-Jun Kang looks up at the tranquil starry night sky over Seoul, smiling with gentle, complete fulfillment as the saga concludes.
panels.prose_hi: Gatha samapt hone par Ha-Jun kang seoul ke shant taron se bhare raat ke aakash ko dekhta hai, aur saumya, purna santushti ke saath muskurata hai.
